name: Hanging Chads
author: American Grand Strategy
about: An example mod: a new card in September 2000, a gentler difficulty and a retitled debate.

events.title: The butterfly ballot
events.body: A county elections supervisor has printed a ballot whose punch holes do not line up with the names beside them. Your lawyers say that in a close race it will cost you thousands of votes, nearly all of them yours.
events.advice: If Florida is close, this is the cheapest point you will buy all year.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.text: Ballot design is not a campaign issue. Until it is.
